description: Source code implementing a simplistic hash map with functions for creation, cloning, insertion, deletion, iteration, and cleanup. It includes internal data structures, hash functions, and iterator mechanisms.

classes.name: icHashMap
classes.description: Main data structure representing the hash map, containing buckets, count, seed, and clone status.

classes.name: icHashMapIterator
classes.description: Iterator structure for traversing hash map entries.

methods.name: searchHashMap
methods.description: Finds a mapItem in the hash map by key.

methods.name: searchBucket
methods.description: Searches within a specific bucket for a key.

methods.name: searchLinkedList
methods.description: Comparison function used during linked list search for matching key.

methods.name: createSeed
methods.description: Generates a seed based on current time for hashing.

methods.name: defaultHash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for a key with a seed.

methods.name: assignedBucket
methods.description: Determines bucket index from hash value.

methods.name: createItem
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new mapItem.

methods.name: destroyItem
methods.description: Frees memory of a mapItem, optionally using a helper.

methods.name: hashMapDeepCloneHelper
methods.description: Helper for deep cloning mapItems during deep clone operation.
